headline: United States and Finland sign a nonbinding deal covering cooperation on an open and secure AI stack
summary: The United States and Finland signed a Technology Prosperity Deal memorandum of understanding on October 29. The document includes intended cooperation on an open and secure super-intelligence stack—which its footnote says Finland uses to mean artificial intelligence—including technology-stack exports, financing coordination, telecommunications and international standards. The MOU is not legally binding and commits neither government to spend funds. The announcement establishes the signed framework and stated intentions, not implementation, financing, deployment or measurable effects.
